{{short description|Danish mathematician}}
[[File:Henning Haahr Andersen 2012.jpg|thumb|Andersen in 2012]]
'''Henning Haahr Andersen''' is a mathematician specializing in [[Algebraic group]]s, [[Lie algebra]]s, [[Quantum group]]s and [[Representation theory]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://home.math.au.dk/mathha/ |title=The Home page of Henning Haahr Andersen |access-date=2015-08-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150525194433/http://home.math.au.dk/mathha/ |archive-date=2015-05-25 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Andersen received his Ph.D. from the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] in 1977 under the supervision of [[Steven Lawrence Kleiman]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=38672|title=Henning Haahr Andersen}}</ref>

In 2012, Andersen became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |title=List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society |access-date=2015-08-17 |archive-date=2018-08-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825194636/http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |url-status=dead }}</ref>
